# Architecture Boundary

Epic26D4SharedState preserves the accepted Mercury model. PowerSync was rejected because its licence, infrastructure, deployment surface, and write model did not address the reproduced client identity defects. Organisation-scoped Supabase Realtime broadcasts only a Work Request identifier and revision; clients then refetch through the authorised read path. A revision-monotonic aggregate store prevents late responses from regressing newer state.

# Editing and Exit Rules

Work Requests are always editable subject to permission and revision compare-and-swap. Draft and Planned are routing vocabulary, never edit gates, and opening a record cannot mutate status. Back navigation never waits for a network write: an immutable exit-save plan continues through a coordinator and a failure remains visible and recoverable.

# Retained Open Decision

Completed and Cancelled terminal-state editability was still awaiting owner decision at the source revision. A future veto may restore terminal guards only; it must not restore Draft or Planned gating, route-edit sessions, silent save/discard, or lock-unlock mode.
